comment: Per-card art metadata for The Augur, keyed by card name. Same shape as card-briefs.json (the Witch file): 'artist' (who is working on it), 'brief' (art direction notes). Status is DERIVED: final art (artFinal in the card data / done here) → Final; else optional 'stage' (assigned | sketching — set via the card-designs page for cards); else artist set → Assigned; else Unassigned. Authored via the card-designs page (Augur tab).
